# fmt

Reflow text paragraphs through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/fmt -w 60 input.txt

moonx cli/fmt -s -w 60 input.txt
```

Read files or stdin and reflow paragraphs using the selected maximum width and goal width.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-w VALUE`, `--width VALUE` | Set maximum width (0 through 2500). Default: `75`. |
| `-g VALUE`, `--goal VALUE` | Set preferred width. |
| `-s`, `--split-only` | Split long lines without joining input lines. |
| `-u`, `--uniform-spacing` | Use one inter-word space and two after sentences. |
| `-p VALUE`, `--prefix VALUE` | Reformat matching prefixed lines only. Default: `""`. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

- Spacing, prefixes and indentation use C-locale byte rules; this is not Unicode-aware typesetting.

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
